notes: The shipped default. AdamW at 3e-4 with betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.1, a constant learning rate and no warmup: a recipe that trains and converges and has not been tuned for this budget. This is the recipe your submission has to beat, and it is also the LOW anchor of the reward scale -- the verifier retrains it from scratch on every grading run rather than reading a stored number for it.
